text:
alex_sales: Heads up — LumenWorks procurement asked for a pack of assurance artifacts for the POC: SOC2 (latest report), ISO27001 cert, and a signed pen-test letter. They need something to attach to their legal + procurement packet by EOD next Tuesday. Any blockers?

maria_security: Need to know scope: are they asking for prod coverage or just POC/staging? Also: do they want full pen-test report or just an attestation letter?

alex_sales: They said "POC environment only" in the request. Prefer a pen-test letter attesting we perform regular tests + statement of no known critical vulns in the last 90d. Procurement asked for network diagram and data residency statement too.

jordan_ps: We can provide SOC2 Type II report + ISO cert PDF, plus a pen-test attestation letter template. For the actual signed letter we'll need legal to sign. Who owns that?

maria_security: Legal usually signs the pen-test attestation. Security can generate the attestation text. We redact customer-identifying info in SOC2 if needed. For the network diagram: do they want high-level or full topology?

ian_eng: Quick note on staging: if LumenWorks wants external vulnerability scan access to our staging IPs, we need to schedule a maintenance window and open a limited set of IPs/ports. That may require Dedicated pool config if we can't expose shared endpoints. Pricing could be impacted if they want isolated staging.

alex_sales: Good call. I asked them if isolation is mandatory; waiting on reply. Timeline is tight. If Dedicated is needed, procurement will ask for an updated quote. Jordan — can you sketch price delta for a short-term reserved pool?

jordan_ps: I can run numbers. Ballpark: adding a single dedicated node for 2 weeks is roughly +$3k on top of POC credits, depends on model size. I'll confirm.

maria_security: For the pen-test attestation letter, here's suggested wording snippet we use internally:

```
Redwood Inference attests that red-team and third-party vulnerability assessments are conducted at least annually. At the time of this attestation (DATE), no critical vulnerabilities affecting the scoped environments were outstanding. For detailed remediation evidence, please open an NDA request.
```

maria_security: We can produce that as a signed PDF. Legal needs to approve final phrasing.

alex_sales: Perfect. Also: they asked for a signed pen-test "letter of attestation" to include in their vendor review. Can we offer a redacted summary of the last external test (CVSS thresholds only)?

maria_security: Yes — we can provide a redacted summary with CVSS buckets (critical/high/medium/low counts) and a one-paragraph remediation status. No raw vuln lists.

ian_eng: Operational ask: to accept external scans against staging we need a ticket to open the following IPs: `52.34.12.0/28` (staging front), `10.20.30.0/24` (internal test net via VPN). Also need presigned S3 path for artifact upload if they want to drop scan reports.

jordan_ps: I can create presigned upload links. Example command for them to upload artifacts: `aws s3 cp scan-report.pdf s3://rw-evidence/lumenworks/ --acl private` (we'll generate presigned URL).

ops-bot: INC-1234 created: "lumenworks assurance evidence handoff" — assigned to security + solutions. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/INC-1234

alex_sales: Action items so far: (1) Maria draft pen-test attestation + redacted summary, (2) Jordan produce short-term dedicated cost delta if isolation required, (3) Ian open ops ticket for IP/scan window, (4) Alex confirm whether LumenWorks will accept redacted reports or insists on raw output. Target: have final pack to procurement by Tue EOD.

maria_security: I'll draft the attestation and redacted summary today and loop in legal. Will flag any legal language changes.

jordan_ps: I'll send a pricing note in this thread by EOD and attach sample presigned URL process.

ian_eng: I'll schedule maintenance window options and post available slots. If they want automated scanning we can be ready in 48 hours after approvals.

alex_sales: Thanks all — I told procurement we should have a pack + letter ready. If legal needs anything from procurement (signatory name, address), I'll collect. :thumbsup:

maria_security: FYI if procurement asks: legal signs as "Redwood Inference, Inc." and QA contact is security@redwood.com.

alex_sales: Good — I'll message procurement that. Will update when LumenWorks confirms isolation requirement.

ops-bot: Note: Document upload location provisioned once presigned URL requested (ticket INC-1234).
